2105-4885-5144-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4885-5144-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4885-5144-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

628-6495-7219.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7219.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-2829-3536-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cheering Fanatic does not have summoning sickness.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-3536-5131--202.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name the artifact.
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat from step 2

1170-1477-5131-6289--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-5131-6289--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

586-864-2292-3125-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2292-3125-5631.description:
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Skeleton Crew.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2099-2869-3184--44.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact with a mana cost of {0}.
Yomiji triggers, returning the artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3532-4668-5078-7719.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3532-4668-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2173-2469-5220-7192.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

141-7339.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Go Ninja Go.
141-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, ensuring to choose its first mode.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Go Ninja Go, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Go Ninja Go, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

792-2511-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
792-2511-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Totentanz and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4702-7220.description:
Activate Glamermite by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the token Glamermite enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the nontoken Glamermite.
Repeat.

3678-6871-6879-7270.description:
Cast Moonglove Extract by paying its mana cost.
When Moonglove Extract enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Moonglove Extract.
Activate Moonglove Extract by sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Moonglove Extract from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Moonglove Extract ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

969-1563-3899-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7155.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1659-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

851-5259-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-5259-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Rude Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2558-2981-7082.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sokka and Suki trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Ally.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a stun counter on it

514-654-2034-5944.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1778-4053-6989.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
When Memnite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

147-3047-5686.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

826-3899-6243-6912.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-3899-6243-6912.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Flash Thompson.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Flash Thompson.
When Flash Thompson dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Flash Thompson from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flash Thompson enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

1939-2034-3000-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Luminous Phantom triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
1939-2034-3000-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

2438-4853-6810.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
2438-4853-6810.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3476-5145-5466-5686.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4826-5175-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
4826-5175-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
4826-5175-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Archelos.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1322-1328-4251.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any Samurai you control.
1170-1322-1328-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Godo.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.exileCardState: encoded on another creature you control

797-2105-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block the creature with Stolen Identity encoded and Combat Celebrant.
You control a Mountain.
797-2105-4068.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Stolen Identity encoded as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Stolen Identity encoded.
Stolen Identity triggers, casting a copy of itself without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Stolen Identity, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
Repeat each combat phase using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

4112-4242-4499-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Sharuum.
Sharuum enters the battlefield, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
